name: Maqhaal Ḍaai'uun
source:
An Arabic short visual novel. You are lost, you don't remember who you are, but you find yourself at a cafe in the middle of a forest... Can the waitress help you remember?

[From [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/who_am_i.shtml]Ren'Py Games List[/url]]
translation:
一部阿拉伯视觉短篇小说。你迷路了，你不记得自己是谁，但你发现自己身处森林中央的一家咖啡馆……女服务员能帮助你记住吗？

[来自[url=http://games.renpy.org/game/who_am_i.shtml]Ren'Py游戏列表[/url]]
